summary.text: Darryl Block is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Rachel Plakon.

paragraphs.text: Block previously sought the Democratic nomination for Florida House District 29 in 2018 and lost the August 28, 2018 primary to Tracey Kagan, 66.8% to 33.2%.
